description: United Brands Limited is a distribution and marketing company, incorporated in 1965 as Batlay Match Industries Limited, renamed UDL Industries Limited in 1987 and United Brands Limited in 2006. It imports, sells and distributes consumer goods through roughly 100 branches and seven warehouses across Pakistan. Multinational brands it has handled include Lindt chocolate, Ovaltine malted drink, Kellogg's cereals and snacks, and Pringles. It is a subsidiary of International Brands Limited.
